title: WS-I Attachments Profile Version 1.0 (Final Material, 2006-04-20)
note: Requirement statements extracted with wsi_requirements.py. The profile is published under WS-I copyright without redistribution terms and is served through a CDN that rewrites contributor addresses per response, so neither the document nor a digest of it is pinned; this extract is reproducible and is what the attachment reference rules cite.

R9999.statement: WIDGETs SHOULD be round in shape.

R2931.statement: The entity body of the root part of multipart/related MESSAGE MUST be a soap:Envelope.

R2945.statement: The Content-Type HTTP header field-value in a MESSAGE MUST be either "multipart/related" or "text/xml". C

R2932.statement: If the Content-Type HTTP header field-value in a MESSAGE has a media-type of "multipart/related" then the Content-Type HTTP header field-value in that message MUST have the type parameter with a value of "text/xml". C

R2915.statement: The entity body of the root part of a multipart/related MESSAGE MUST be serialized using either UTF-8 or UTF-16 character encoding.

R2916.statement: Non-root parts of a multipart/related MESSAGE MAY use any character encoding.

R2925.statement: If the WSDL description lists at least one non-root MIME part, the corresponding MESSAGE MUST have a Content-Type HTTP header field-value with a media-type of "multipart/related".

R2917.statement: A MESSAGE containing zero attachment parts MUST be sent using a content-type of either "text/xml" as though a SOAP HTTP binding were used or "multipart/related" when the WSDL description for the message specifies the mime:multipartRelated element on the corresponding wsdl:input or wsdl:output element in its wsdl:binding.

R2902.statement: A SENDER MUST NOT send a message using SOAP with Attachments if the corresponding wsdl:input or wsdl:output element in the wsdl:binding does not specify the WSDL MIME Binding.

R2918.statement: A RECEIVER MAY ignore a URI reference to an attachment in an envelope.

R2919.statement: A MESSAGE MAY contain soap:Envelope s carried as attachments in parts that are not the root part of the message.

R2920.statement: An INSTANCE MAY send a fault with attachments if and only if the wsdl:output element is described using the WSDL MIME binding.

R2933.statement: If a description binds a wsdl:message part to a mime:content element, then the corresponding MIME part's content-id field-value in a MESSAGE MUST conform to the content-id part encoding.

R2921.statement: A RECEIVER MUST NOT infer any semantics from the ordering of non-root MIME parts in a message.

R2929.statement: A MESSAGE MAY have its MIME parts in any order provided that the identity of the root part is maintained.

R2922.statement: If the Content-Type HTTP header field-value in a message does not have a start parameter, a RECEIVER MUST treat the first body part of the MIME package as the root part. C

R2934.statement: The Content-Transfer-Encoding field of a part in a multipart/related MESSAGE MUST have a value of "7bit", "8bit", "binary", "quoted-printable" or "base64".

R2935.statement: The encoding of the body of a part in a multipart/related MESSAGE MUST conform to the encoding indicated by the Content-Transfer-Encoding field-value, as specified by RFC2045. C

R2936.statement: In a MESSAGE, all MIME encapsulation boundary strings MUST be preceded with the ascii characters CR (13) and LF (10) in that sequence. C

R2901.statement: A DESCRIPTION MUST use either the WSDL MIME Binding as described in WSDL 1.1 Section 5 or WSDL SOAP binding as described in WSDL 1.1 Section 3 on each of the wsdl:input or wsdl:output elements of a wsdl:binding.

R2941.statement: A wsdl:binding in a DESCRIPTION SHOULD bind every wsdl:part of a wsdl:message in the wsdl:portType to which it refers to one of soapbind:body, soapbind:header, soapbind:fault, soapbind:headerfault, or mime:content.

R2903.statement: A mime:content element in a DESCRIPTION MUST NOT reference a wsdl:part that is not present in the respective wsdl:input or wsdl:output of the corresponding wsdl:operation of the corresponding wsdl:portType.

R2904.statement: A mime:content element in a DESCRIPTION MUST NOT be bound to a sub-component of an element or type referenced by a wsdl:part.

R2946.statement: In a DESCRIPTION, a mime:content element MUST include the part attribute.

R2940.statement: In a DESCRIPTION, a wsdl:part defined with the ref:swaRef schema type SHOULD only be bound to a soapbind:body, or a soapbind:header in a MIME binding.

R2928.statement: In an ENVELOPE, a URI reference that is typed using the ref:swaRef schema type MUST resolve to a MIME part in the same message as the envelope.

R2911.statement: A mime:multipartRelated element in a DESCRIPTION MUST contain exactly one mime:part element, amongst its child mime:part elements, containing a soapbind:body child. C

R2905.statement: The soapbind:header element in a DESCRIPTION MAY be included as a child of the mime:part element. C

R2906.statement: A soapbind:header element in a DESCRIPTION MUST NOT be included in a mime:part that is not the root part, containing the soapbind:body element. C

R2907.statement: MIME parts in a DESCRIPTION MUST be defined using an element with a local name of part in the namespace of the WSDL MIME Binding extension. C

R2908.statement: The mime:part element in a DESCRIPTION MUST NOT have a name attribute.

R2909.statement: Multiple mime:content child elements of a mime:part element in a DESCRIPTION MUST reference the same wsdl:part.

R2910.statement: A mime:content in a DESCRIPTION MUST reference a wsdl:part that is defined using either the type attribute or the element attribute.

R2942.statement: In a MESSAGE, a message part bound to a mime:content that refers to global element declaration (via the element attribute of the wsdl:part element) MUST be serialized within the MIME part as a serialization of an XML infoset whose root element is described by the referenced element.

R2943.statement: In a DESCRIPTION, if a message part is bound to a mime:content that refers to a type (via the type attribute of the wsdl:part element), then the value of that type attribute MUST be ignored in favor of media type of the type attribute of the mime:content element.

R2944.statement: In a DESCRIPTION, if a wsdl:part element refers to a global element declaration (via the element attribute of the wsdl:part element) then the value of the type attribute of a mime:content element that binds that part MUST be a content type suitable for carrying an XML serialization.

R2912.statement: A RECEIVER MUST NOT assume that the order of mime:part elements specified in a WSDL description is the same as the order of MIME parts in the message.

R2947.statement: In a DESRIPTION, a mime:part element that contains a soapbind:body child element MAY appear in any position amongst the other child elements of a mime:multipartRelated element.

R2913.statement: A Fault MESSAGE MAY be serialized as either text/xml or multipart/related, if the wsdl:output child element of the corresponding binding operation in a description has a child mime:multipartRelated element.

R2930.statement: A wsdl:fault element in a DESCRIPTION MUST NOT have mime:multipartRelated element as its child element.

R2923.statement: A SENDER MAY send non-root MIME parts not described in the WSDL MIME binding. C

R2926.statement: A MESSAGE MUST include all of the MIME parts described by its WSDL MIME binding.

R2927.statement: The root part of a MESSAGE MUST be conformant with all the requirements for an envelope in version 1.1 of the Basic Profile.
